activation_rate.numerator: Participants who complete consented corpus setup and independently recover at least one known item with matching source evidence opened during their first session.
activation_rate.denominator: Consented participants who start setup, including setup and retrieval failures; withdrawn data is excluded and its count disclosed separately.

no_result_disclosure.numerator: Completed negative queries with zero unsupported results and an explicit no-match disclosure.
no_result_disclosure.denominator: All completed negative queries, including disclosure failures and queries returning unsupported results.

decisions.advance: All numeric thresholds pass, including at least 70% first-session activation with nonzero denominators, at least 8 participants complete the known-item task set, at least 2 return unaided, and no unresolved critical privacy or source-loss issue exists.
decisions.narrow: Retrieval and source integrity remain safe but activation, latency, capture friction, or a non-critical cohort slice misses its threshold; publish the failure and narrow scope before adding formats or capture.
decisions.stop: Any critical privacy/source-integrity defect, fabricated or unanchored result, unrecoverable data loss, or failure of the rights-clean benchmark makes the next expansion ineligible.
